newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 4.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's edition of Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - MCI Communications Corp, which is partnered with News Corp Ltd in American Sky Broadcasting, will merge with British Telecommunications Inc . BT already owned a 20-percent stake in MCI and will acquire the remaining 80 percent for $20.1 billion in stock and cash.

HOLLYWOOD - As a result of Time Warner Inc's merger with Turner Broadcasting System Inc, Jean MacCurdy has added oversight of Hanna-Barbera Inc. to her duties as president of Warner Bros. Television Animation and head of Kids' WB! Fred Seibert, president of Hanna-Barbera, resigned.
